title: Saved project JSON and result NPZ files load, round-trip and refuse a newer schema by name

project_files: examples/open_mode_network.json (project nested under a mode-network wrapper)
tests/fixtures/projects/demo_waveguide.json, demo_scatterer.json, demo_3d.json, demo_pmc.json (the four workbench examples frozen at schema 1)

tests/fixtures/projects/graded_ade_plane.json (graded Yee mesh with a refinement box, multipole ADE material, broadband plane source with a wavelength range, point and x-normal plane monitors, PEC y walls, float64 on the CPU)
tests/fixtures/projects/minimal_defaults.json (hand-written file with no schema_version and no region: every absent field takes its default)
tests/fixtures/projects/tiny_result.json (the project of the two result files)
result_files: tests/fixtures/npz/tiny_2d_complete.npz (2D 20 x 20 cells, 40 steps, snapshot every 10 steps, one Ez point monitor, CPU float32)
tests/fixtures/npz/tiny_2d_cancelled.npz (the same run cancelled after step 20: partial state)
fixture.generator: tests/fixtures/generate_fixtures.py; frozen files are never regenerated in place, a schema change adds new files beside them
fixture.older_schema: none exists: schema_version has been 1 since the field was introduced, so no hand-written older version and no migration beyond the stub are possible
fixture.future_schema: schema_version 2 injected into demo_waveguide.json and into the project string of tiny_2d_complete.npz

reference_method: the file's own contents: every field present in a file must be present and equal after Project.model_validate, model_dump_json, model_validate_json and save/load; derived mesh coordinates, time step, shape and resolved sources and monitors must be identical between the loaded and the validated project; the result arrays, summary and recomputed spectra must equal the stored ones after Result.load and after a save/load cycle

observables.name: field_subset_equality
observables.definition: recursive equality of every key present in the source file against the model dump (lists elementwise, scalars exact)

observables.name: mesh_nodes_equality
observables.definition: numpy array equality of Region.mesh_nodes per axis between the loaded and the validated project

observables.name: result_state
observables.definition: summary backend, precision, units string, steps, requested_steps, cancelled, termination_reason, warnings list; times and signals lengths equal the completed steps; frames count equals frame_steps

observables.name: spectrum_recomputation
observables.definition: Result.spectra recomputed from the restored signals against the stored monitor_0_spectrum

observables.name: future_version_error
observables.definition: the ValidationError message names schema_version 2 and schema 1

acceptance.field_subset_equality: exact for every file listed in the fixture
acceptance.result_state: exact values as listed in tests/test_project_compatibility.py; cancelled file has cancelled true, termination_reason cancelled, steps 20 of 40
acceptance.future_version_error: Project.model_validate, Project.load and Result.load all raise pydantic.ValidationError matching 'schema_version 2 is newer than schema 1'
acceptance.source_of_limits: COMPLETION_PROGRAM_KO.md G8-01; exact equality because the files are the reference, no numerical tolerance beyond the float64 spectrum recomputation

not_yet_covered: result files written by an earlier torchfdtd release (none are archived; the frozen NPZ files start with this case)
streamed, tensor-batch and mode-network result formats (their own loaders, outside Result.load)
warnings raised during a run are stored in summary['warnings'] and restored as a list; no fixture yet carries a non-empty warning list

notes: Declared on branch g8-packaging from 2b64f91 before the recorded run. migrate_project in torchfdtd/models.py is the migration stub; Project runs it as a before-validator so every loader (JSON, NPZ, API payloads) refuses a newer schema with the same message.
